pass_rule.definition: mean over leads 1-4 of the held-out INCREMENTAL gain of control+new over control must reach both thresholds, and the lead-mean gain must be > 0 for both metrics in BOTH half-year directions; coverage below min_coverage gives INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE (not a pass)

scope: retrospective bidirectional development screen on the D1 validation year; linear/IRLS correction only, no forecaster retraining; incremental over the 11 existing upstream features + night flag; archival qc-version-1 values with an assumed 1 h availability lag
